_comment: Single source of truth for news. Feeds both news/index.html and the Latest News section on the home page. Normally created by the 'Post news' issue form via .github/workflows/news-from-issue.yml, and safe to edit by hand. Items sort on 'date'; 'dateRange' is what a reader sees when an event spans several days. Set 'featured' on the items that should appear on the home page.

items.headline: SAAIL Lab Paper Accepted at CVPR 2026 — Vision for Agriculture Workshop, Denver
items.body: CLOVES-4603: the first public benchmark dataset for clove quality grading — 4,603 images, 99.67% deep learning accuracy. A proud moment for SAAIL Lab at one of AI's most prestigious venues.
items.imageAlt: CVPR 2026 V4A Workshop — CLOVES-4603 Paper Acceptance

items.headline: Paper Accepted at ICLR 2026 — Trustworthy AI Workshop, Rio de Janeiro
items.body: Can one framework make AI fairer, more robust, and more generalizable at once? SAAIL Lab's accepted paper at ICLR 2026's Trustworthy AI Workshop says yes — and shows exactly how.
items.imageAlt: ICLR 2026 Paper Acceptance - Trustworthy AI Workshop

items.headline: CARA-FM Poster — Best Poster at DLI 2025, Featured by AI4Africa
items.body: What if AI was built for Africa from the ground up? This award-winning poster at Deep Learning Indaba 2025 caught the attention of AI4Africa's global network. See why it's sparking conversations about the future of AI on the continent.
items.imageAlt: AI4Africa Weekly Research Spotlight — CARA-FM Framework

items.headline: Paper at 4th EAC STI Conference — Kigali, Rwanda · Travel Grant $980
items.body: Zanzibar's most valuable spice — graded by AI for the first time. Built with farmers, not just for them. This work earned a competitive travel grant and a stage in Kigali to tell Africa's story.
items.imageAlt: EAC STI Conference 2026 - Clove Quality Grading

items.headline: New Publication in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
items.body: Our paper on "Rectifying the extremely weakened signals for cassava leaf disease detection" published (IF: 7.7).

items.headline: Joined IIT Madras Zanzibar as Assistant Professor
items.body: Thrilled to join IIT Madras Zanzibar Campus as Assistant Professor of Data Science & AI, establishing SAAIL Lab for transformative AI research in East Africa.

items.headline: "DGS-Bench" paper accepted at Deep Learning Indaba 2026, Lagos
items.body: "DGS-Bench: Measuring the Deployment Gap in African Agricultural AI Requires Balanced Metrics — A Cassava Case Study," accepted at the Deep Learning Indaba in Lagos, Nigeria — one of only 19 accepted for publication, the second year running. The poster is presented on Wednesday 5 August during the poster sessions.
items.imageAlt: DGS-Bench poster session announcement, Deep Learning Indaba 2026, Lagos

items.headline: Three SAAIL Lab presentations at Data Science Africa 2026, Kampala
items.body: SAAIL Lab presented three pieces of work at Data Science Africa 2026, held at Makerere University in Kampala, Uganda: one oral presentation and two posters. The posters covered an audit of representation in crop disease benchmark datasets intended for sub-Saharan African deployment, and few-shot transfer learning for cassava leaf disease detection under East African field conditions.
items.imageAlt: Dr. Innocent Nyalala at Data Science Africa 2026, Makerere University, Kampala
